fact_text: EV Technologies assembles its EV125 electric motorcycle in Pakistan, and the CEO said the company also makes the bike's batteries itself.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: At the start, about 65-70% of the parts for the EV125 were sourced locally in Pakistan, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: After the company began making its own batteries, about 80% of the EV125's parts are bought from the local market, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The motor and its controller are not available in Pakistan and are imported, the CEO said, and certified testing of such parts is needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO said a lithium battery in an electric bike lasts at least about 5 to 7 years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO said an electric bike has few parts needing routine upkeep, such as bushings, so most ongoing maintenance cost of a petrol bike is removed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO put the fuel cost of a petrol bike at about Rs 7 to 8 per kilometre, and said her figure understates the actual petrol price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO put the electricity cost of an electric bike at about Rs 1 to 1.5 per kilometre.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: Electric bikes carry a sales tax (GST) of about 1%, compared with 18% on most goods, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO said her company pays about 35-40% duty on EV parts it must import because they are not made in Pakistan, and asked for the EV policy to be reviewed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: Government policy targets electric two-wheelers making up 30% of motorbikes on Pakistan's roads by 2030, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO said electric bikes sell predominantly in Punjab rather than Sindh.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: Water resistance is graded by IP ratings such as IP67; no EV bike is fully waterproof, so it can ride in rain but should not be submerged, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO said changing an electric bike's tyre takes about 10 to 15 minutes depending on skill, since many EV bike motors sit inside the rear wheel.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: Women make up about 7-8% of the company's technicians, and the CEO said the assembly line was all male when she joined.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO set a target of a 50-50 split of men and women among the company's technicians, to be reached by about 2028.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO acknowledged mixed industry reviews on after-sales service for electric bikes, which she linked to the technology being new.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan lacks certified laboratories that can verify the quality of batteries and components made by EV makers, and that such testing is needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: An electric bike has no gears or clutch and runs on throttle and brake alone, which the CEO said makes it easier for women to ride.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)

fact_text: The CEO said Wavetek, the group she joined, earns more than 70% of revenue from exports and has offices in the US, Mexico, Europe and the UAE.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'EV Technologies: Building Pakistan’s mobility future and empowering women | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-05-08)
